About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Senior Manager, Payroll Operations (Remote - USA / Canada)

Payroll Operations is where production payroll gets made right: remittances, check issuing, one-off payments, reversals, and the cases that arrive when something needs fixing, across union and non-union productions. The Senior Manager owns how that work runs. You will lead a Team Lead and a group of specialists covering both union and non-union payroll, and own the team's partnership surface with Finance, Tax Operations, Union Payroll, and Product.

This is a genuine leadership role with direct accountability for operational outcomes and KPI performance. You will set clear owners, priorities, and standards, and inspect against them so issues surface early. You will also build a team that raises problems early, learns from errors without blame, and always weighs the impact on productions and the workers they employ.

What You'll Do:

Run payroll operations

  • Own the case queue, routing, and prioritization across union and non-union work: set and hold the team's service levels, rebalance load across people, and know ticket volume and aging at any point

  • Keep remittances, check issuing, one-off payments, and reversals accurate and on time

  • Own payment controls, including approvals for one-off payments and corrections

  • Run a clear escalation model with defined owners and response standards, and set clear guardrails for what the team can decide versus bring up, so decisions happen at the right level without constant escalation

  • Own the escalation path for complex or novel operational problems, and coach the team through the hard calls rather than taking them over

  • Own how the team responds to internal requests, with clear ownership and response standards

Raise quality and report results

  • Build and run a quality program for the team's payroll work, and hold the team accountable for improving its own processes

  • Turn recurring errors into training, SOP, or process fixes, described by cause rather than by person

  • Hold the team to keep SOPs owned and current, turn recurring problems into reusable frameworks, and track the impact of errors and share themes with Finance and leadership

  • Set the team's targets and own its KPIs, including remittance accuracy and case service levels; read team-level metrics to coach and reprioritize, and escalate trends rather than incidents, with drivers and actions, to senior leaders

  • Track pending customer credits and report trends and drivers to leadership

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage a team lead and specialists: set targets, run regular 1:1s, coach against each person's metrics, hold career conversations, and build development plans

  • Build cross-training and coverage plans, define advancement paths, and onboard new hires effectively

  • Lead the team through change: explain the why, set expectations, and manage the productivity dip that follows new tools, processes, or structure

  • Build a candid, blameless culture where people raise problems early, and model it by naming your own misses

  • Set the tone that the team wins together: default to collaboration over territory, and break silos across the department

  • Make customer trade-offs explicit, weighing impact on productions and workers against cost and effort, and coach the team to make those trade-offs well on their own

Partner and plan

  • Build a quarterly plan for the team with Client Operations leadership, and surface capacity and staffing needs as volume grows

  • Partner with Finance, Tax Ops, Union Payroll, Success, Support, RevOps, and Enablement, with clear response expectations

  • Be a strong voice for operations in product priorities, so what ships reflects how the work really runs

AI is a requirement of this role

In this role, we expect you to lead on AI by example, not delegate it.

  • Build with AI yourself, including agents, workflows, and automations, so you can model good practice, judge what is worth building, and coach your team to build their own

  • Take an AI-first approach to how your team's work gets done, and use AI where your team can see it

  • Align with the team's AI champions on what gets built, so effort goes where it pays off

  • Protect your team's time to learn, including AI certification

  • Complete Wrapbook's AI certification for people leaders

What You'll Have:

  • 5 to 8+ years in payroll operations, ideally including union payroll or an EOR or PEO environment

  • 3+ years of people management, ideally in a high-volume, fast-growing environment, with a record of developing people and growing them into stronger roles

  • Strong knowledge of payroll remittances, reversals, adjustments, and related compliance requirements

  • Experience managing a case queue and service-level metrics, and improving them through process changes

  • Experience setting team targets and SLAs and managing capacity across a team

  • Skill at using data to explain performance, diagnose root causes, and communicate clearly to senior leaders

  • A manager's mindset: set owners and standards, inspect against them, and escalate with substance

  • Experience leading a team through change, including explaining the why and managing the productivity dip

  • Hands-on AI experience, which is required for this role: you use it daily, have built agents or workflows yourself, and can coach a team to do the same

  • Candor: you raise problems early and treat errors as process gaps rather than personal failures

  • Sound judgment on customer trade-offs

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across Finance, Product, and operations teams

  • Nice to have: entertainment, media, or production payroll experience; union payroll rules and remittances; Salesforce case management and SLA configuration


Why Join Us

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

  • Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

  • Learning and Development opportunities

  • Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.
